description: Next generation e2e testing framework for web and mobile apps.

detail.readme: # e2e [e2e](https://e2e.com?utm_source=e2e&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme_intro) is an end-to-end testing framework for web and mobile apps. Describe a goal in natural language and an agent drives the app to reach it. Check the result with locators and assertions in the same test. ```ts // tests/checkout.e2e.ts import { test, expect } from 'e2e'; test('a member upgrades to Pro', async ({ app, agent, screen }) => { await app.open('/settings/billing'); await agent.act('upgrade the workspace to the Pro plan'); await agent.assert('the invoice preview shows a prorated amount'); await expect(screen.getByRole('status')).toContainText('Pro'); }); ``` An agent step that a later assertion verifies records its actions, and the next run replays them with no model calls until the app changes. Tests without agent steps need no model. Bring your own subscription, API key, or local model. ## Quick start ```bash npx e2e init ``` `init` asks for an engine, web or mobile, and a model provider, then writes a config and an example test. The [quickstart](https://e2e.com/docs/quickstart) covers the rest. To see a finished setup in your stack, open [`examples/`](https://github.com/tester-army/e2e/tree/main/examples): Vite, Next.js, Astro, Angular, Expo, SwiftUI, Jetpack Compose, Kotlin Multiplatform, Flutter, and .NET MAUI, each a standalone project with a passing suite. ## Packages ### Core | Package | What it does | | --- | --- | | [`e2e`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/e2e) | The SDK, runner, and CLI. | | [`@e2e-dev/web`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/web) | Browser engine: Chromium, Firefox, and WebKit through Playwright. | | [`@e2e-dev/mobile`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/mobile) | iOS and Android engine: simulators and emulators through agent-device. | | [`@e2e-dev/decision`](https://e2e.com/docs/decision-models) | Decision-model executors for bounded semantic actions and assertions, and `decisionFilter()`, which leaves out the tests a pull request is unlikely to affect. | | [`@e2e-dev/acp`](https://e2e.com/docs/subscriptions#use-your-coding-agent) | Runs agent steps on your own coding agent (Claude Code or Codex) over the Agent Client Protocol. | ### Integrations | Package | What it does | | --- | --- | | [`@e2e-dev/kernel`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/kernel) | Kernel hosted browsers for the web engine. | | [`@e2e-dev/lightpanda`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/lightpanda) | Lightpanda, the open-source headless browser, started per run for the web engine. | | [`@e2e-dev/smol`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/smol) | smol machines browsers for the web engine: by default, each attempt branches a warm Chromium microVM. | | [`@e2e-dev/testmu`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/testmu) | TestMu AI (formerly LambdaTest) hosted Android emulators, iOS simulators, and real devices for the mobile engine, and hosted Chrome and Edge for the web engine. | | [`@e2e-dev/e2b`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/e2b) | E2B sandboxes: Android 16 for the mobile engine, and Chromium for the web engine. | | [`@e2e-dev/browserstack`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/browserstack) | BrowserStack App Automate real Android and iOS devices for the mobile engine. | | [`@e2e-dev/limrun`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/limrun) | Limrun hosted iOS simulators and Android emulators for mobile tests. | | [`@e2e-dev/eas`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/eas) | Expo Simulators hosted iOS simulators and Android emulators for the mobile engine. | | [`@e2e-dev/github`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@e2e-dev/github) | Reporter that posts results as a pull request comment. | ### Community Packages built on e2e's public API and maintained outside this repository. | Package | What it does | | --- | --- | | [`e2e-cige`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/e2e-cige) | [CIGE](https://www.amazon.science/publications/cige-an-agentic-ai-test-case-standard) test cases (Context, Intent, Guardrails, Execution) as JSON, run through `agent.act` and `agent.assert`, with run summaries and checks for agents that repair failing tests. Source: [vivekkrishna/cige](https://github.com/vivekkrishna/cige). | ## Documentation [e2e.com/docs](https://e2e.com/docs). The `e2e` package ships every page, so coding agents can read them offline in `node_modules/e2e/docs`. ## Join us Join us in changing how software gets tested. [We are hiring.](https://e2e.com/careers?utm_source=e2e&utm_medium=github&utm_campaign=readme_hiring) Questions? Ask on [Discord](https://tester.army/discord). Issues are for bugs and feature requests. Want to hack on e2e? See [Contributing](./CONTRIBUTING.md). We prefer an issue or a Discord discussion before a pull request. ## Security Please don't open public issues for security vulnerabilities. Follow [SECURITY.md](./SECURITY.md) and report them to [security@e2e.com](mailto:security@e2e.com). ## Telemetry The CLI sends anonymous usage data, such as which commands and engines run and where runs fail, but no test content, app content, or credentials. Opt out with `npx e2e telemetry disable` or `E2E_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1`. [Telemetry](https://e2e.com/docs/telemetry) lists every field. ## Status > [!NOTE] > e2e is in active development on the way to 1.0. APIs and config can still > change between minor releases.
